note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #26, Q3 2024 Public Safety Perception) keeps the 59 INEGI columns bp1_1..bp1_9_6 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0924.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); the bookmark's keep list is identical to Q1's #18. mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's Q3 data dictionary labels every BP1_* column (e.g. BP1_2_08 'Percepcion de seguridad en el cajero automatico localizado en la via publica'; BP1_5_4 'Cambiar sus habitos respecto a permitir que los (las) menores de edad que viven en el hogar salgan solos(as)...'; BP1_6_12 '...No lo hace'; BP1_9_5 'Percepcion del grado de confianza en la Fuerza Aerea Mexicana'); 59/59 labels agree in content with the Q3 questionnaire sub-item/option carrying the same number, and catalogos/bp1_*.csv value labels agree with the printed option codes for every question. Q3 vs Q1/Q2 (checked against the Q3 print, the Q3 dictionary and the raw CSV, not assumed): question 1.6 is the Q1 form -- three main ways of learning about public safety, 14 0/1 indicators bp1_6_01..bp1_6_13, bp1_6_99 -- NOT Q2's household-victimization block (bp1_6_1..6); Q3 dictionary, catalogos and raw columns all carry the two-digit bp1_6_* set, and the .do comment reads 'news sources Q1/Q3'. Two wording differences from Q1 (batch_675): (a) 1.5 item 4 is REWORDED -- Q1/Q2 print 'permitir que salgan de su vivienda sus hijos(as) menores?', Q3 prints 'permitir que los (las) menores de edad que viven en el hogar salgan solos(as)?'; INEGI's dictionary label for BP1_5_4 changes the same way between the 0324/0624 and 0924 dictionaries; (b) 1.6 option 99 prints 'No sabe / no responde' (Q1 'No sabe/ no responde'). Everything else in Section I (CP1, all stems, sub-items, options, fills) is string-identical to Q1. Words: text_source=study_materials, the administered Q3 questionnaire wording (not the terser dictionary labels). Unlike Q1, the Q3 PDF text layer carries every stem (1.1-1.9 incl. the 1.7/1.8/1.9 stems and 1.9 options): all 74 distinct questionnaire strings shipped are exact substrings of pdftotext -raw/-layout output after whitespace normalisation, and 90-dpi renders of pp.2-3 were read to confirm; the one other string, option_text 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', is INEGI's catalogo label. Structure (batch_675 convention): CP1 read-aloud intro in instructions; one section_id per question 1.1-1.9; for 1.2 and 1.4-1.9 the stem is in section_prompt and the sub-item/row in item_text; 1.1 and 1.3 are single items with the stem in item_text. Kept as printed: '(LUGAR)', '(CIUDAD)', '(AUTORIDAD)', 'la (al)', 'la (del)', 'la (el)' fills; '(a)'/'(as)' gender fills; trailing '?' and '...'; 1.1 and 1.3 options with their trailing '?'; 'Otro'/'Otra' write-in rows as the bare word; '[CDMX (3)]' row label on bp1_7_1 only. Normalised: line wraps joined. Stripped: question/option numbers, dot leaders, entry boxes, blank write-in lines, 'ESPECIFIQUE', interviewer directions (CIRCULE UN SOLO CODIGO; REGISTRE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION; MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'A' Y CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; PASA AL SIGUIENTE RENGLON; the 1.7 No-aplica and 1.8/1.9 skip notes). Options: printed labels mapped to the catalogo codes (identical in both); only levels present in the live data get rows (no row for 3 'No aplica' / 9 'No sabe / no responde', set missing by the .do). bp1_6_* option_text 1='Si' and 0='No se declaro como opcion afirmativa' are INEGI catalogo labels, not questionnaire text. Every level each item's respondents used has an option row (59/59). Cross-check (route 9 style, .cache/mexico_2024_q3safety_perception/counts.R): raw Q3 CSV 24096 rows; live 1265926 rows over 24096 ids, 0 duplicate id-item; all 59 live item vectors reproduce the raw file after the .do's recodes -- 295/295 item x level (0-4) counts identical, e.g. bp1_1 1/2 = 10480/13557 (9=59), bp1_3 1..4 = 6808/4745/7273/4848 (9=422), bp1_5_4 1/2 = 7252/11003 (3=5822, 9=19), bp1_6_01 0/1 = 10163/13933, bp1_6_99 0/1 = 24032/64, bp1_9_1 1..4 = 1170/6671/4045/3265. bp1_8_k/bp1_9_k are blank in the raw file for exactly the respondents with bp1_7_k != 1 (8884/5514/3286/2372/11994/6480; 0 blanks with bp1_7_k==1), per the questionnaire's skip rule. Step 3b: live items match Section I exactly (59 = 1.1, 1.2 x12, 1.3, 1.4 x8, 1.5 x5, 1.6 x14, 1.7-1.9 x6 each). Dictionary defect: Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2024 Q3 wave (file suffix 0924) -- same as the siblings. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation): reused verbatim from batch_675 for every string identical to Q1 (incl. bp1_6_99 'Doesn't know / no answer', whose Spanish differs only in spacing); bp1_5_4 translated fresh for this table ('allowing minors who live in the household to go out alone?'). INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, tercer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section I (questions 1.1-1.9) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, took the 0/1 labels for the question 1.6 information-source indicators (including its 'No sabe / no responde' and 'Otra' indicators, which are shipped as items) from INEGI's data catalogue, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
